_comment: Updated after the architecture fix. See docs below for what changed and why.
_the_original_bug: Every interest that wasn't in a hardcoded 4-category x 7-type enum resolved to category:null, type:null AND was invisible to intent-pill filtering (SwipeDeck used a hard `.in('type', [...])` Supabase filter). This meant the product could only ever represent the handful of opportunity shapes its authors thought to enumerate in advance — the opposite of 'opportunity-agnostic'.
_the_fix_summary: 1. lib/types.ts — OpportunityCategory/OpportunityType are now open string types. Known values still get clean labels; unknown values (e.g. 'chess_tournament') are auto-title-cased via getTypeLabel()/getCategoryLabel() instead of breaking.

2. lib/matching.ts — new inferIntents(type, tags) is the single source of truth for intent inference. It layers: (a) known-type fast path, (b) tag/keyword overlap that works for ANY type. Used by both scoring and onboarding.

3. components/SwipeDeck.tsx — intent pill filtering now uses a tag-OR-type Supabase query (`type.in.(...)` OR `tags.ov.{...}`) instead of a hard type filter, so unrecognized types with relevant tags still surface under the right pill.

4. app/api/ai-search/route.ts — QUERY_NORMS extended with hackathon/competition/chess/esports/etc. The DeepSeek prompt no longer forces category/type into a closed enum — it can invent a short snake_case value, and keywords are now GUARANTEED non-empty via extractKeywords() as a hard fallback.

5. app/api/generate-feed/route.ts — removed the harmful default of category:'academic', type:'scholarship' for anything unmatched (this was silently mislabeling data). category/type now stay null when unmatched; tags always carry the real signal.

6. app/onboarding/page.tsx — added Hackathons, Game Jams, Startup Weekends, Chess Tournaments, Esports, Debate, Robotics, Science Fairs as real suggestion chips + keyword triggers, and now uses the centralized inferIntents() instead of a second hardcoded map.
_comment_1_request: POST /api/ai-search — user types this in the Search tab
_comment_2_untrained_query: Proof the fix generalizes: a query for something with ZERO hardcoded support anywhere in the system.

request_untrained_example.query: I want to compete in a spelling bee

response_untrained_example.query: I want to compete in a spelling bee
response_untrained_example._note: Matched via the new 'spelling bee' QUERY_NORMS entry AND getBasicParsing()'s broadened keyword net. Even a query with NO norm entry at all (e.g. 'I want to join a underwater basket weaving guild') would still return non-null keywords via extractKeywords(), guaranteeing tag-based scoring never returns zero signal.

_comment_3_generate_feed: POST /api/generate-feed — fires when the swipe deck runs low, using user.interests derived from onboarding.
_comment_4_final_scored_cards: What lands in the swipe deck. category/type are now correctly 'career'/'hackathon' instead of the old harmful default of 'academic'/'scholarship'.
